scripts.start:phone: IFACE=$(route get default 2>/dev/null | awk '/interface:/{print $2; exit}'); IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr "$IFACE" 2>/dev/null || ifconfig | awk '/inet / && $2 != "127.0.0.1" {print $2; exit}'); if [[ "$IP" == 172.20.* ]]; then echo "Warning: IP $IP ressemble a un hotspot iPhone. Expo Go peut timeout. Prefere un Wi-Fi routeur."; fi; EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://$IP:4000 npx expo start --go --lan -c
scripts.start:phone:lan: IFACE=$(route get default 2>/dev/null | awk '/interface:/{print $2; exit}'); IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr "$IFACE" 2>/dev/null || ifconfig | awk '/inet / && $2 != "127.0.0.1" {print $2; exit}'); if [[ "$IP" == 172.20.* ]]; then echo "Warning: IP $IP ressemble a un hotspot iPhone. Expo Go peut timeout. Prefere un Wi-Fi routeur."; fi; echo "Using LAN IP: $IP"; EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://$IP:4000 npx expo start --go --lan -c --port 8081
